tag_t7.tisch.hinweis: Put a package together. You see the other side's verdict at once; only the offer itself costs capital.
tag_t7.rat.hinweis: In the game the 13 states that appear as actors count (simplified); the rest follow them. Greece and Cyprus exercise their veto via the conflict values, the others only withhold unanimity in extreme positions.
tag_t7.dienst.satz: Covert operations cost capital and part of the scarce capacity, rarely succeed cleanly and can be exposed.
tag_t7.dienst.bericht: The world only learns what is exposed; here you see what you ordered or what was uncovered.
tag_t7.verm.satz: Ankara has a line to both sides. The situation must ripen, spoilers work against it, and an agreement only holds if someone guarantees it.
